Subject: Credit Ratings of Interloop Limited by VIS
Dear Sir,
In accordance with Section 96 ofthe Securities Act, 2015 and Clause 5.6.1(a) of PSX Regulations, we hereby
convey thefollowinginformation:
We are pleased to inform you that the VIS Credit Rating Company Ltd. (VIS), a “Full Service’ rating agency
providing independent rating services in Pakistan in its Press Release of April 20, 2021 has assigned an
initial entity ratings of^A+/A-1'(Single A plus/Single A-One) to Interloop Limited(ILP).The copy of the
abovementionedPressReleaseisattached.
You may please inform the TRE Certificate Holders of the Exchange accordingly.
Yours Sincerely,
ForINTERLOOPLIMITED
Faisalabad
